rows.name: utf_7
rows.source:
import _codecs
retained = None
class Position:
    def __index__(self):
        assert input() == 'resume'
        retained.object = b'AB'
        return -1
def handler(error):
    global retained
    retained = error
    assert error.__traceback__ is None
    print(error.encoding, error.object, error.start, error.end, error.reason)
    return ('?', Position())
_codecs.register_error('fd-replace', handler)
result = _codecs.utf_7_decode(b'\xff', 'fd-replace', True)
assert result == ('?B', 1)
assert retained.object == b'AB'
assert retained.args[1] == b'\xff'
print(result)
